seeds.path: tool: every seed is a distinct engine seed; reserved block E1.fixConfirm of tools/fixtures/study_seed_plan_3aB.json

arms.note: quick-mode strong side bottom (the live shortcut writes early + mid focusLane)
no dragon and no economy component: baseline for a colour asymmetry not specific to an option

matches: control 1,200 + primary 2 x 2 x 1,200 = 4,800 + safety/reference 3 x 2 x 400 = 2,400 => 8,400 matches (~3 h, 3 workers)

primary.estimand: D = mean over seeds of (Delta_red - Delta_blue); Delta_side = (treatment on that side) - (control), both from that side's view, same seed; a seed counts only if all three records have the metric (match ended in the early phase => null)

verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, or fewer than 90% of the planned seeds are valid; never reported as PASS, the Owner decides

primary.report: Delta_blue, Delta_red, and D split by 'the treated side is the dragon side' (objectiveLayoutForSeed; STANDARD = blue is the dragon side); report only
primary.precedence: STOP takes precedence: a 90% CI entirely outside the margin is STOP even with fewer than 90% valid seeds; otherwise fewer than 90% valid seeds => INCONCLUSIVE

economicMeaning: 150 gold = half a kill (kill 300, assist share 150) = about 1.2% of a team's gold at the end of the early phase (~13,000 in C6 samples) = 0.17 SD of the control's early gold lead (SD 886) = about half of the map's dragon-side early advantage (+227/+332)
power: from C6 variance (not evidence): SD of the side difference 1,362-1,661 => at n=1200 SE 39-48; TOST power at a true D of 0 about 0.86 (SD 1,661) to 0.97 (SD 1,362)

guards.pairing: per arm and side, same-seed pairs against the control from the same side's view; the safety/reference arms use seeds 66001-66400

items.rule: paired z <= -3 (own team gold at the end of the early phase drops)
the treated side's win rate is outside [0.40, 0.60] (point estimate); safety band only, never a claim that a tactic is favourable

items.level: WARN at ratio >= 1.9 (point); STOP when the lower 95% bound of the ratio > 2.0
items.rule: ratio = mean(treatment) / mean(control); 95% CI of the ratio from the paired difference divided by the control mean

low events (control mean < 0.5 deaths per match): WARN if the absolute increase >= 0.25 deaths per match with paired z >= 3; otherwise WARN if rel >= +50% AND absolute increase >= 0.15 deaths per match AND paired z >= 3

guards.validity: every STOP-level guard (own gold, win band, ganks) needs valid pairs >= 90% of the arm's planned seeds; otherwise that guard is a data gap and the overall verdict is at most INCONCLUSIVE (a STOP still wins)
guards.ratioCi: ganks ratio 95% CI = 1 + (paired-difference CI) / control mean; the control mean's own uncertainty is ignored (declared; this makes STOP slightly easier, i.e. conservative for safety)

interactions.rule: per seed (combo - a - b + ctrl) on seeds 66001-66400; report; flag if |z| >= 3

overall: STOP if any primary comparison, STOP-level guard or instrument/error rule says STOP; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE if any primary comparison is INCONCLUSIVE, any STOP-level guard has a data gap, or any match errored; otherwise PASS. WARN and interaction flags are listed for the Owner.
noOptionalStopping: verdicts are computed only on complete data; partial batches are never evaluated
notClaimed: no win-rate claim; no coefficient, engine or rule change in response to a STOP/WARN without the Owner
errors: errored matches (errors.jsonl) are never retried or replaced and are listed by seed; any errored match => the verdict is at most INCONCLUSIVE; more than 1% of the planned matches errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
instrumentCheck: every record (live and again at report time): balanceTool.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, phaseStudySim.v3, skills/passives/curve on, talents off, empty selfCheck; any failure => HALT file / STOP(INSTRUMENT)

copiedFrom.note: check_formal_acceptance_3aB compares these field by field with the original after mapping the seed ranges

requiresResult.why: stopRules.ga8: the confirmatory G-A8 runs FIRST and a STOP halts every other formal measurement; INCONCLUSIVE goes to the Owner. Enforced by the tool, not by procedure
